query: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure OCI revenue Q4 fiscal 2025 quarter ended May 2025
normalized: 2025 cloud ended fiscal infrastructure may oci oracle q4 quarter revenue

output.content: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)—reported as Cloud Infrastructure (IaaS)—generated **$3.0 billion of revenue in Oracle’s fiscal Q4 2025**, the three months ended **May 31, 2025**. That was **52% growth year over year**; Oracle also said OCI *consumption* revenue grew **62%** in the quarter. [[1]]

sources.title: Oracle - Oracle Announces Fiscal 2025 Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Full Year Financial Results
